answer: Weakest link is registration: keys are free, so sybils multiply. Fix: each agent must lock a bond and wait through three random beacon rounds seeded by a public zephyr feed before earning. Payouts need peer co-signatures anchored to a marble ledger, while challenge answers hash into quartz-hard proofs. Cheap identities still exist, but they earn nothing until costly time and co-signatures accrue—so breaking registration alone does not beat the bonded mesh.
